command.xrayconfig: Advanced log, policy and FakeDNS settings
xray.section.list:
🧩 *Advanced Xray settings*

Manage logging, connection policies and FakeDNS pools. Select a section to inspect or change its native JSON.
xray.section.detail:
🧩 *%s*
Status: %s

Common settings are shown below. File paths, extensions and other values require the sensitive JSON export.
xray.section.note.log: Log file paths must be writable by Xray. Reset removes the explicit log configuration and restores Xray's defaults.
xray.section.note.policy: Timeouts and buffer sizes use Xray's native policy format. Required user and inbound statistics switches remain enabled after replacement or reset.
xray.section.note.fakedns: Pools may be one object or an array. DNS servers and inbound sniffing are configured separately. After reset, Xray may initialize default pools if DNS still uses fakedns.
xray.section.prompt: Send the native JSON value for %s as text or a document up to 1 MiB, without the enclosing section-name key. /cancel cancels. Telegram chats are not end-to-end encrypted; use the local agent CLI for sensitive input.

route.test.title: 🔎 *Runtime routing query*
route.test.prompt:
Send a domain or IP, optionally with a port:
`example.com` · `example.com:8443`
`udp 1.1.1.1:53` · `[2001:db8::1]:443`
Default: TCP / port 443.

Advanced: send JSON text or a .json document, for example:
```
{"domain":"example.com","port":443,"inbound_tag":"raw","user":"alice","protocol":"tls"}
```

This evaluates the running core. It may resolve DNS, trigger configured routing webhooks and advance a balancing strategy. It does not test target connectivity. Input remains active for 10 minutes; /cancel returns to routing.
route.test.disabled: RoutingService is not enabled. An administrator with mutation permission can enable its loopback-only API after confirmation.
route.test.enable_confirm:
🔎 *Enable runtime routing queries*
Validate the loopback-only RoutingService, save the configuration and restart Xray? The API also supports route changes, so public or ambiguous API configurations are refused.
route.test.enabled: RoutingService enabled. Send a target to query.
route.test.groups: Balancer chain reported by the core: %s
route.test.no_match: The core reported no matching rule. Normal dispatch would use its default outbound.
route.test.saved_default: Default in the saved configuration: `%s` (hint; external runtime changes may differ).
route.test.continue: This is a routing decision, not a connectivity test. Evaluation may resolve DNS, trigger configured webhooks and advance balancing state. Send another target or JSON context to continue; /cancel exits.
wizard.text_required: Send the requested value as text, or /cancel.

help.body:
📖 *Freedom Bot Help*

① `/start` — Dashboard
② `/users` — Manage users, UUIDs and inbound assignments
③ `/nodes` — Manage REALITY and XHTTP inbounds
④ `/traffic` — User traffic; `/inboundtraffic` — Inbound traffic
⑤ `/online` — Online clients and observed source IPs
⑥ `/stats` — Statistics collection switches and repair
⑦ `/version` — Local and upstream versions
⑧ `/update` — Update manager and Bot; core updates require confirmation
⑨ `/restart` — Restart Xray after confirmation
⑩ `/language en|zh-CN` — Select interface language

Commands: `/adduser phone`, `/disableuser phone`, `/enableuser phone`.

🔒 Management is limited to authorized private chats. Changes and core updates require explicit permissions.

stats.title:
📊 Statistics switches

Xray controls these switches; when one is off, the related feature cannot collect data:
stats.xff: ℹ️ XHTTP inbounds without trustedXForwardedFor: %s (needed only behind a CDN; ignore for direct connections)

stats.repairconfirm:
Repair statistics?

This enables user and inbound counters and adds a loopback-only Stats API listener and route if needed. Existing incompatible listeners are rejected.

The configuration is validated before one Xray restart; active sessions may reconnect briefly, and failures roll back automatically.

network.outbound.prompt: Send a native Xray outbound JSON object with tag and protocol, as text or a document up to 1 MiB. Existing tags are replaced; new tags are appended. Example: {"tag":"block2","protocol":"blackhole"}. Telegram Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted: use the local agent CLI for credentials. /cancel cancels.
network.outbound.deleteprompt: Send the outbound tag to delete. The default, API, referenced outbounds and outbounds with balancers are protected. /cancel cancels.
network.dns.prompt: Send the complete native Xray DNS JSON object as text or a document up to 1 MiB, for example {"servers":["1.1.1.1"]}. This replaces the existing DNS object. Telegram Bot chats are not end-to-end encrypted: use the local agent CLI for secrets. /cancel cancels.
serverhost.prompt: Send the public hostname or IP used by REALITY client links, or - to use automatic discovery. /cancel cancels.
serverhost.confirm: Use %s as the public link address? This takes effect on the next export without restarting Xray.
service.ask.collector: Install or refresh the independent statistics collector? This changes its systemd service and may restart Xray to enable statistics.
service.done.collector: Statistics collector installed and started. Check Online diagnostics for policy and API status.

balancer.native.create_prompt:
➕ *Import a balancer*
Send one native balancer JSON object as text or a .json document (up to 1 MiB). The tag must be new.

Example:
```
{"tag":"pool","selector":["proxy-"],"strategy":{"type":"random"}}
```

A confirmation follows. /cancel exits.

📝 *Replace balancer* `%s`
Export its sensitive JSON first to retain advanced settings. Send the complete replacement object as text or a .json document (up to 1 MiB), keeping the same tag. Omitted fields are removed.

A confirmation follows. /cancel exits.
